name: MediaFetch Pro Adobe CEP
releaseNotes: v1.0.7: Streamlined Songs category filters directly in filter dropdown, native crystal-clear Apple Music preview player with authentic Apple badge and artwork, universal Behance video/gallery extraction (Vimeo/YouTube embeds & direct MP4s), instant 4-tier clipboard paste button across Pro and Standard, and automatic player fallback from restricted embeds to Direct Stream.
Massive download speed boost across all media formats with optimized 4MB chunking & 128KB low-latency buffers.
Ultra-fast live-stream clip trimming: downloads only the exact segments needed for your clip instead of multi-hour streams.
Support for multi-item carousels, playlists, and cloud storage links.
Bulletproof download engine with automatic Range-based connection resume and retry.
